entries.matn_ar: «أَحِبَّ فِي اللَّهِ، وَأَبْغِضْ فِي اللَّهِ، وَوَالِ فِي اللَّهِ، وَعَادِ فِي اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّمَا تُنَالُ مُوالَاةُ اللَّهِ بذَلِكَ، وَلَنْ يَجِدَ عَبْدٌ طَعْمَ الْإِيمَانِ وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ صَلَاتُهُ وَصَوْمُهُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ كَذَلِكَ، ولَقَدْ صَارَتْ عَامَّةُ مُؤَاخَاةِ النَّاسِ عَلَى أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا، وذَلِكَ لَا يُجْدِي عَنْ أَهْلِهِ» . ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هاتَيْنِ الآيَتَيْنِ: {لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ} [المجادلة: 22] الْمُجَادَلَةُ وَقَرَأَ {الْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ} [الزخرف: 67] الزُّخْرُفُ الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: al-Husayn b. 'Ali al-Ju'fi informed us. He said: Za'ida b. Qudama narrated to us. He said: Layth b. Abi Sulaym narrated to us, from Mujahid, from Ibn 'Abbas, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Love for God’s sake, hate for God’s sake, befriend for God’s sake, and be hostile for God’s sake, for the friendship of God is attained only by that; and a servant will never taste the sweetness of faith, however much his prayer and fasting, until he is thus. Indeed, most of the fraternity of people has come to be over worldly matters, and that avails its people nothing.” Then Ibn 'Abbas recited these two verses: “You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day” [Q. 58:22] (al-Mujadila); and he recited “Friends on that Day will be, to one another, enemies” [Q. 43:67] (al-Zukhruf)—the verse.

sections.title_en: Chapter: The passing away of knowledge

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «هَلْ يُدْرَى كَيْفَ يَنْقُصُ الْإِسْلَامُ؟» قَالُوا: كَيْفَ؟ قَالَ: «كَمَا تُنْقِصُ الدَّابَّةَ سَمْنَهَا، وَكَمَا يَنْقُصُ الثَّوْبُ عَنْ طُولِ اللُّبْسِ، وَكَمَا يَقْسُو الدِّرْهَمُ عَنْ طُولِ الْخَبْوِ، وَقَدْ يَكُونُ فِي الْقَبِيلَةِ عالِمَانِ، فيَمُوتُ أحَدُهُمَا فَيَذْهَبُ نِصْفُ عِلْمِهِ، ويَمُوتُ الْآخَرُ فَيَذْهَبُ عِلْمُهُمْ كُلُّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, who said: I heard Ibn Mas'ud say:
entries.matn_en: “Do you know how Islam diminishes?” They said: How? He said: “As an animal loses its fat, and as a garment wears thin from long use, and as a dirham hardens from long hoarding (khabw). And there may be in a tribe two scholars; one of them dies and half of his knowledge goes, and the other dies and all of their knowledge goes.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: Legal obligations (al-takālīf al-sharʿiyya) are part of faith

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ الرَّحَبِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، مَقْبِلَهُ مِنَ الشَّامِ عَنْ خِصَالٍ عَنِ الْإِيمَانِ، فَتَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {لَيْسَ الْبِرَّ أَنْ تُوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ} [البقرة: 177] الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Yazid b. Harun narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Husayn informed us, from Abu 'Ali al-Rahabi, from 'Ikrima, who said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Hasan b. 'Ali was asked, on his return from Syria, about the qualities of faith, and he recited this verse: “Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east and the west” [Q. 2:177]—the verse.

sections.title_en: Chapter: The description of the Muslim

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، سَمِعَهُ مِنَ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَتَخَلَّلُ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَ فِي مكَانٍ آخَرَ يَتَخَطَّى رِقَابَ النَّاسِ فقَالَ: أَخْبِرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ: وَوَجَدْتُ فِي مكَانٍ آخَرَ: حَدِّثْنِي بِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَا تُحَدِّثْنِي عَنِ الْعِدْلَيْنِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Khalid, who heard it from al-Sha'bi. He said: And Dawud b. Abi Hind narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man came, picking his way through [the people] until he reached 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr—and he narrated in another place that he came stepping over the necks of the people—and said: Tell me something you heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ. Ibn Abi 'Umar said: And I found in another place: Narrate to me a hadith that you heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ, and do not narrate to me from the two loads (al-'idlayn). He said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “The Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe, and the emigrant is one who abandons what God has forbidden him.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: Religion is sincere advice (naṣīḥa)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ، الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ، الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ» قَالَ: قُلْنَا: لِمَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «للَّهِ ولِرَسُولِهِ، ولِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَلِكِتابِهِ، ولِأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from 'Ata' b. Yazid al-Laythi, from Tamim al-Dari, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Religion is sincere advice; religion is sincere advice; religion is sincere advice.” He said: We said: For whom, O Messenger of God? He said: “For God, for His Messenger, for the righteous among the believers, for His Book, and for the leaders of the Muslims.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: The most excellent of people in faith are the most excellent of them in knowledge (maʿrifa)
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ أفْضَلُ النَّاسِ إِيمَانًا أفْضَلُهُمْ مَعْرِفَةً

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا كُوفِيٌّ لَنَا - أوْ كُوفُيُّونَ -، عَنْ أَبِي السَّوْدَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ سَابِطٍ، رِوَايَةً قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَفْضَلُكُمْ إِيمَانًا أَفْضَلُكُمْ مَعْرِفَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us. He said: A Kufan of ours—or Kufans—narrated to us, from Abu al-Sawda', from Ibn Sabit, as a transmitted report (riwayatan). He said:
entries.matn_en: “The most excellent of you in faith are the most excellent of you in knowledge.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا زَالَتِ الْخُصُومَةُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى خَاصَمَ الرُّوحُ الْجَسَدَ، فقَالَ الْجَسَدُ: يَا رَبِّ إِنَّمَا كُنْتُ مِثْلَ الْخَشَبَةِ النَّخِرَةِ، لَيْسَ لِي يَدٌ أَبْطُشُ بِهَا، وَلَا عَيْنٌ أُبْصِرُ بِهَا، وَلَا أُذُنٌ أسْمَعُ بِهَا، وَلَا رِجْلٌ أمْشِي بِهَا، وَلَا عَقْلٌ أَعْقِلُ بِهِ، حَتَّى جَاءَ هَذَا فَدَخَلَ فِيَّ، فَنَجِّنِي مِنْهُ، وخَلِّدْ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابَ الْيَوْمَ. وقَالَ الرُّوحُ: يَا رَبِّ مِنْكَ الرُّوحُ وَأَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ، إِنَّمَا كُنْتُ كَالشِّهَابِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِي يَدٌ أَبْطِشُ بِهَا، وَلَا عَيْنٌ أُبْصِرُ بِهَا، وَلَا أُذُنٌ أسْمَعُ بِهَا، وَلَا رِجْلٌ أَمْشِي بِهَا، وَلَا عَقْلٌ أَعْقِلُ بِهِ، حَتَّى جِئْتُ فَدُخِّلْتُ فِي هَذَا الْجَسَدِ، فَخَلِّدْ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابَ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْهُ الْيَوْمَ، فَقِيلَ: يُضْرَبُ لَكُمَا مَثَلٌ مَثَلُكُمَا كَمَثَلِ أَعْمَى ومُقْعَدٍ، دَخَلَا حَائِطًا دَانِيَةً ثِمَارُهَا، فَالْأَعْمَى لَا يُبْصِرُ الثِّمَارَ فَيَتَنَاوَلَ مِنْهَا، وَالْمُقْعَدُ يُبْصِرُهَا وَلَا يَنَالُهَا، فَدَعَا الْمُقْعَدُ الْأَعْمَى، فقَالَ: احْمِلْنِي حَتَّى أُسَدِّدَكَ، فَآكُلَ وأُطْعِمَكَ، فَحَمَلَهُ وَسَدَّدَهُ، فَأَدْرَكَا وَهُمَا كَذَلِكَ، فعَلَى أيِّهِمَا يَقَعُ الْعَذَابُ؟ قَالَ: عَلَيْهِمَا جَمِيعًا، قَالَ: فَالْعَذَابُ عَلَيْهِمَا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Sa'd, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Disputation among people will not cease on the Day of Resurrection until the spirit disputes with the body. The body will say: My Lord, I was only like a rotten log; I had no hand with which to strike, no eye with which to see, no ear with which to hear, no foot with which to walk, and no mind with which to reason, until this one came and entered me. So save me from it and make the punishment on it eternal today. And the spirit will say: My Lord, from You is the spirit, and You created it; I was only like a flame, having no hand with which to strike, no eye with which to see, no ear with which to hear, no foot with which to walk, and no mind with which to reason, until I came and was made to enter this body. So make the punishment on it eternal, and save me from it today. Then it will be said: A parable is struck for you both: your parable is that of a blind man and a lame man who entered an orchard whose fruits hung low; the blind man cannot see the fruits to take from them, and the lame man sees them but cannot reach them. The lame man called the blind man and said: Carry me so that I may guide you aright, so that I may eat and feed you. So he carried him and guided him, and they reached [the fruit] while they were thus. Upon which of them will the punishment fall? He said: Upon both of them together. He said: So the punishment is upon both of them.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: The sin of one who withholds zakāt

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا مِنْ صَاحِبِ إِبِلٍ لَا يُؤَدِّي حَقَّهَا، وَمِنْ حَقِّهَا حَلْبُهَا يَوْمَ وِرْدِهَا إِلَّا بُطِحَ لَهَا بِقَاعٍ أوْ بِصَعِيدٍ قَرْقَرٍ، فَتَسْتَنُّ عَلَيْهِ، تَطَؤُهُ بِأَخْفَافِهَا كُلَّمَا مَضَى آخِرُهَا رُدَّ عَلَيْهِ أَوَّلُهَا. وَمَا مِنْ صَاحِبِ بَقَرٍ لَا يُؤَدِّي حَقَّهَا وَمِنْ حَقِّهَا حَلْبُهَا يَوْمَ وِرْدِهَا إِلَّا بُطِحَ لَهَا بِقَاعٍ أوْ بِصَعِيدٍ قَرْقَرٍ، فَتَسْتَنُّ تَطَؤُهُ بِأَظْلَافِهَا، وتَنْطَحُهُ بِقُرُونِهَا كُلَّمَا مَضَى آخِرُهَا رُدَّ أَوَّلُهَا. وَمَا مِنْ صَاحِبِ غَنَمٍ لَا يُؤَدِّي حَقَّهَا، وَمِنْ حَقِّهَا حَلْبُهَا يَوْمَ وِرْدِهَا إِلَّا بُطِحَ لَهَا بِقَاعٍ أوْ بِصَعِيدٍ قَرْقَرٍ تَطؤُهُ بِأَظْلَافِهَا وتَنْطَحُهُ بِقُرُونِهَا لَيْسَ فِيهَا جَمَّاءُ، وَلَا مَكْسُورَةُ الْقَرْنِ. وَمَا مِنْ صَاحِبِ كَنْزٍ لَا يُؤَدِّي زَكَاتَهُ إِلَّا مُثِّلَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شُجَاعٌ أَقْرَعُ فاغِرًا فَاهُ، يَطْلُبُهُ وَهُوَ يَفِرُّ مِنْهُ، ويَقُولُ: أنَا كَنْزُكَ الَّذِي خَبَّأْتَهُ، وَلَا يَنْتَهِي حَتَّى يَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي فِيهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no owner of camels who does not pay their due—and part of their due is milking them on the day they come to water—but that he will be laid out for them in a level plain or on smooth, bare ground, and they will tread on him with their feet; whenever the last of them has passed, the first of them is brought back upon him. And there is no owner of cattle who does not pay their due—and part of their due is milking them on the day they come to water—but that he will be laid out for them in a level plain or on smooth, bare ground, and they will trample him with their cloven hooves and gore him with their horns; whenever the last of them has passed, the first of them is brought back. And there is no owner of sheep who does not pay their due—and part of their due is milking them on the day they come to water—but that he will be laid out for them in a level plain or on smooth, bare ground, and they will trample him with their cloven hooves and gore him with their horns; there will be none among them hornless or with a broken horn. And there is no owner of a treasure who does not pay its zakat but that there will be made to appear to him on the Day of Resurrection a bald serpent with its mouth open, pursuing him while he flees from it, saying: I am your treasure that you hoarded; and it will not stop until it puts his hand in its mouth.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أعْيَنَ، وجَامِعِ بْنِ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ لَا يُؤَدِّي زَكَاةَ مَالِهِ إِلَّا جُعِلَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي عُنُقِهِ شُجَاعٌ» ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُصَادِقَهُ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: {وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ} الْآيَةَ. وقَالَ مَرَّةً: ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِصْدَاقَهُ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: {سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ} [آل عمران: 180] الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Malik b. A'yan and Jami' b. Abi Rashid, from Abu Wa'il, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud (r), reaching the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no man who does not pay the zakat of his wealth but that on the Day of Resurrection a serpent will be placed around his neck.” Then the Messenger of God ﷺ recited to us its confirmation from the Book of God: “And let not those who are miserly with what God has given them of His bounty think…” [the verse]. And on another occasion he said: Then the Messenger of God ﷺ recited to us its confirmation from the Book of God: “They will be collared with what they were stingy with on the Day of Resurrection” [Q. 3:180]—the verse.

sections.title_en: Chapter: Mention of the Khawārij and their attributes

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ يَقْسِمُ قَسْمًا إِذْ جَاءَهُ ابْنُ ذِي الْخُوَيْصِرَةِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، فقَالَ: اعْدِلْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تَعْدِلْ. قَالَ: «وَيْلَكَ فَمَنْ يَعْدِلُ إِذَا لَمْ أَعْدِلْ» قَالَ عُمَرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي فَأَضْرِبْ عُنُقَهُ، قَالَ: " دَعْهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ أَصْحَابًا يَحْتَقِرُ أحَدُكُمْ صَلَاتَهُ مَعَ صَلَاتِهِمْ وَصِيَامَهُ مَعَ صِيَامِهِمْ، يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لَا يُجَاوِزُ ⦗ص: 138⦘ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ يُنْظَرُ فِي قُذَذِهِ فَلَا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ فِي نَضِيِّهِ فَلَا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ فِي رِصَافِهِ فَلَا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ فِي نَصْلِهِ فَلَا يَجِدُ فِيهِ شَيْئًا قَدْ سَبَقَ الْفَرْثَ الدَّمُ آيَتُهُمْ رَجُلٌ أسْوَدُ إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ مِثْلُ ثَدْيِ الْمَرْأَةِ أوْ مِثْلُ الْبَضْعَةِ تَدَرْدَرُ يَخْرُجُونَ عَلَى فُرْقَةٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ قَالَ: وفِيهِمْ نَزَلَتْ {ومِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُلْمِزُكَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ} [التوبة: 58] التَّوْبَةُ. قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ: أَشْهَدُ أنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، وأشْهَدُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا حِينَ قَتَلَهُمْ وأنَا مَعهُ جِيءَ بِالرَّجُلِ عَلَى النَّعْتِ الَّذِي نَعَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. Mu'adh narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
entries.matn_en: While the Messenger of God was distributing a portion, Ibn Dhi al-Khuwaysira al-Tamimi came to him and said: Be just, O Messenger of God, for you have not been just. He said: “Woe to you! Who will be just if I am not just?” 'Umar said: O Messenger of God, permit me to strike off his neck. He said: “Leave him, for he has companions: one of you will think his prayer small beside their prayer and his fasting small beside their fasting. They recite the Qur'an but it does not pass [p. 138] their collarbones; they pass out of the religion as the arrow passes out of the quarry: [the archer] looks at its fletching (qudhadh) and finds nothing in it; then he looks at its shaft (nadiyy) and finds nothing in it; then he looks at its binding (risaf) and finds nothing in it; then he looks at its head (nasl) and finds nothing in it—the blood has outstripped the dung. Their sign is a black man, one of whose arms is like a woman’s breast, or like a piece of flesh, quivering. They will emerge at a time of division among the people.” He said: And about them was revealed {And among them are those who criticize you concerning the charities} [Q. 9:58] (al-Tawba). Abu Sa'id said: I testify that I heard this from the Messenger of God, and I testify that 'Ali, when he fought them, while I was with him, had the man brought, in the very description that the Messenger of God had described.

sections.title_en: Chapter: Which Islam is best?

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ الزَبِيدِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَادَاهُ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أيُّ الْإِسْلَامِ أفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنْ يَسْلَمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِكَ وَيَدِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: al-Muqri' narrated to us. He said: al-Mas'udi narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Murra, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Harith, from Abu Kathir al-Zubaydi, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, from the Prophet ﷺ, that
entries.matn_en: a man called out to him: O Messenger of God, which Islam is best? He said: “That the Muslims be safe from your tongue and your hand.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: The call to the two testimonies and the laws (sharāʾiʿ) of Islam
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ الدُّعَاءُ إِلَى الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ وَشَرَائِعِ الْإِسْلَامِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السُّرِّيِّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ، فقَالَ: «إِنَّكَ سَتَأْتِي قَوْمًا أَهْلَ كِتَابٍ، فَإِذَا أَتَيْتَهُمْ فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى أَنْ يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أطَاعُوكَ بذَلِكَ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَطَاعُوا لَكَ بذَلِكَ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَغْنِيَائِهِمْ فَتُرَدُّ عَلَى فُقَرَائِهِمْ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَطَاعُوا لَكَ بِذَلِكَ فَإِيِّاكَ وَكَرَائِمَ أَمْوَالِهِمْ. وَاتَّقِ دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ، فَإِنَّهَا لَيْسَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ عز وجل حِجَابٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Bishr b. al-Sari narrated to us. He said: Zakariyya b. Ishaq narrated to us, from Yahya b. 'Abd Allah b. Sayfi, from Abu Ma'bad, from Ibn 'Abbas, that the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: sent Mu'adh b. Jabal to Yemen and said: “You will come to a people, People of the Book. When you come to them, call them to testify that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God. If they obey you in that, inform them that five prayers are obligatory upon them in a day and a night. If they obey you in that, inform them that a charity (sadaqa) is obligatory upon them, to be taken from their rich and returned to their poor. If they obey you in that, then beware of the choicest of their wealth. And beware the supplication of the wronged, for between it and God, mighty and majestic, there is no veil.”

sections.title_en: Continuation of the chapter on the departure of faith upon committing acts of disobedience
sections.title_ar: تَابِعْ بَابَ زَوَالِ الْإِيمَانِ عِنْدَ ارْتِكَابِ الْمَعَاصِي

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَشْرَبُ رَجُلٌ الْخَمْرَ حِينَ يَشْرَبُهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “A man does not drink wine, at the time he drinks it, while he is a believer.”

sections.title_en: Continuation of the chapter on the call to the two testimonies and the laws of Islam
sections.title_ar: تَابِعْ بَابَ الدُّعَاءِ إِلَى الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ وَشَرَائِعِ الْإِسْلَامِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: الْمُجَالِدُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى جَدِّي وَهَذَا كِتَابُهُ عِنْدَنَا، وحَدَّثَنِي ذَلِكَ أشْيَاخُ الْحَيِّ، " بسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ إِلَى عُمَيْرٍ ذِي مُرَّانَ وَإِلَى مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ هَمْدَانَ، سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ، إِنِّي أَحْمَدُ إِلَيْكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ. أَمَّا بَعْدُ: فَإِنَّهُ بَلَغَنَا إسْلَامُكُمْ مَرْجِعَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِ الرُّومِ، فَأَبْشِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ هَدَاكُمْ بِهُدَاهُ، وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذَا شَهِدْتُمْ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَأَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَأَنْطَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ، فَإِنَّ لَكُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ، وَذِمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، عَلَى أمْوالِكُمْ وَدِمَائِكُمْ وَأرْضِ الْبُورِ الَّتِي أسْلَمْتُمْ عَلَيْهَا، سَهْلِهَا وَجَبَلِهَا ومَرَاعِيهَا وَغُيُولِهَا، غَيْرَ مَظْلُومِينَ ومُضَيَّقٍ عَلَيْهِمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Usama Hammad b. Usama narrated to us. He said: al-Mujalid informed us of that. He said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to my grandfather, and this letter of his is with us, and the elders of the tribe narrated it to me: “In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful. From Muhammad, the Messenger of God, to 'Umayr Dhu Murran and to those of Hamdan who have embraced Islam: Peace be upon you. I praise to you God, besides whom there is no god. To proceed: It has reached us that you have embraced Islam, on our return from the land of the Romans. So rejoice, for God has guided you with His guidance. And if you bear witness that there is no god but God alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, and you establish the prayer and give (antaytum) the zakat, then you have the protection of God and the protection of Muhammad, the Messenger of God, over your wealth and your blood and the barren land (ard al-bur) on which you embraced Islam—its plain and its mountain, its pastures and its streams (ghuyul)—not wronged and not constrained.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: The dislike of assuming leadership (imāra)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عِيسَى الرَّمْلِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ: إِنِّي اخْتَرْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي فَعَلِّمْنِي شَيْئًا آخُذُ بِهِ، قَالَ: قَدْ أرَدْتَ ذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُولَ لِي: «تَعْبُدَ اللَّهِ وَلَا تُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَلَا تَأَمَّرَ عَلَى رَجُلَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. 'Isa al-Ramli narrated to us. He said: al-A'mash narrated to us, from Sulayman b. Maysara, from Tariq b. Shihab, from Rafi' b. Abi Rafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Abu Bakr al-Siddiq: I have chosen you for myself, so teach me something to hold to. He said: You had wished for that before you said it to me: “You worship God and associate nothing with Him, establish the prayer, give the zakat, fast Ramadan, and do not take command over two men.”

sections.title_en: Continuation of the chapter on following the Sunna

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أيْمَنَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، يَأْمُرَ: " أَنْ أَقْرَأَ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ عَلَى النَّاسِ: أَمَّا بَعْدُ: فَإِنَّا نُوصِيكُمْ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَنَحُثُّكُمْ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، ونَرْضَى لَكُمْ طَاعَتَهُ، ونَسْخَطُ لَكُمْ مَعْصِيَتَهُ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِعِلْمِهِ فَأَحْكَمَهُ، وَفَصَّلَهُ وأَعَزَّهُ، وحَفِظَهُ أَنْ يَأتِيَهُ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ، وضَرَبَ ⦗ص: 146⦘ أمْثَالَهُ، وَبَيَّنَ عِبَرَهُ، وَجَعَلَهُ فُرْقَانًا مِنَ الشَّرِ، ونُورًا مِنَ الظُّلْمَةِ، وَبَصَرًا مِنَ الْعَمَى، وهُدًى مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، ثُمَّ تَمَّتِ النِعْمَةُ، وأُكْمِلَتِ الْعِبَادَةُ، وَحُفِظَتِ الْوَصِيَّةُ، وَجَرَتِ السُّنَّةُ وَمَضَتِ الْمَوْعِظَةُ، واعْتَقَدَ الْمِيثَاقُ، واسْتُوجِبَتِ الطَّاعَةُ، فَهُوَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ الْمَتِينُ، وَالْعُرْوَةُ الْوُثْقَى لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا، بِهَا سَبَقَ الْأَوَّلُونَ، وَبِهَا أَدْرَكَ الْآخِرُونَ، كِتَابًا تَوَلَّى حُكْمَهُ، وارْتَضَاهُ لِنَفْسِهِ، وافْتَرَضَهُ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ، مَنْ حَفِظَهُ بَلَّغَهُ مَا سِوَاهُ، ومَنْ ضَيَّعَهُ لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ غَيْرُهُ، أَمَّا بَعْدُ: فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تبارك وتعالى أَنْزَلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النُّبُوَّةَ، وابْتَعَثَهُ بِالرِّسَالَةِ، رَحْمَةً لِلنَّاسِ كَافَّةً، وَالنَّاسُ حِينَئِذٍ فِي ظُلْمَةِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وضَالَّتِهَا، يَعْبُدُونَ أوْثَانَهَا، وَيَسْتَقْسِمُونَ بَأَزْلَامِهَا، عَنْهَا يَأْتَمِرُونَ أمْرَهُمْ، وَبِهَا يُحِلُّونَ حَلَالَهُمْ، وَيُحَرِّمُونَ حَرَامَهُمْ، دِينُهُمْ بِدْعَةٌ، وَدَعْوَتُهُمْ فِرْيَةٌ، فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ عز وجل بِالْحَقِ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم، رَحْمَةً مِنْهُ لَكُمْ ومِنَّةً مَنَّ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ، وبَشَّرَكُمْ وأَنْذَرَكُمْ ذِكْرَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ مِنَ الْأُمَمِ، وَقَصَّ فِي الْكِتَابِ قِصَّةَ أمْرِهِمْ، كَيْفَ نَصَحَتْ لَهُمْ رَسُلُهُمْ، وكَيْفَ كَذَّبُوهُمْ وتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُمْ، وكَيْفَ كَانَتْ عُقُوبَةُ اللَّهِ إيَّاهُمْ، فَوَعَظَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِنَكَالِ مَنْ قَبْلَكُمْ، وأمَرَكُمْ أَنْ تَقْتَدُوا بِصَالِحِ فِعَالِهِمْ، فَبَلَّغَ مُحَمَّدٌ الرِّسَالَةَ، وَنَصَحَ الْأُمَّةَ، وَعَمِلَ بِالطَّاعَةِ، وجَاهَدَ الْعَدُوَّ، فَأعَزَّ اللَّهُ بِهِ أمْرَهُ، وأظْهَرَ بِهِ نُورَهُ، وتَمَّتْ بِهِ كَلِمَتُهُ، وانْتَجَبَ لَهُ أقْوَامًا عَرِفُوا حقَّ اللَّهِ، واعْتَرَفُوا بِهِ، وبَذَلُوا لَهُ دِمَاءَهُمْ وأمْوَالَهُمْ، فِيهِمْ مَنْ هَجَرَ دَارَهُ وعَشِيرَتَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ عز وجل، ومِنْهُمْ آوَى ونَصَرَ فآسَوْا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَآسَوْا بِهِ. وَلَمْ يرْغَبُوا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ، فأيَّدَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الدِّينَ، ودَمَغَ الْحَقُّ ⦗ص: 147⦘ الْبَاطِلَ، وأُبْطِلَتْ دَعْوَةُ الطَّوَاغِيتِ، وَكُسِرَتِ الْأَزْلَامُ، وتُرِكَتْ عِبَادَةُ الْأَوْثَانِ، وَأُجِيبَ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وظَهَرَ دِينُ اللَّهِ، وَعَرَفَ النَّاسُ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ عز وجل، واعْتَرَفُوا بِقَضَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَشَهِدُوا بِالْحَقِّ، وَقَالُوا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وأدَّوْا فَرَائِضَ اللَّهِ عز وجل، وأَعْقَبَ اللَّهِ نَبِيَّهُ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنِ اسْتَجَابَ لَهُ أجْرًا ونَصْرًا وَوَعْدًا وَسُلْطَانًا، وَمَكَّنَ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ الَّذِي ارْتَضَى، وأَبْدَلَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوفِهِمْ أمْنًا، فَلَمَّا أحْكَمَ اللَّهِ النَّهْيَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِهِ، وَخَلُصَتِ الدَّعْوَةُ، وايْتَطَى الْإِسْلَامُ لِأَهْلِهِ، شَرَّعَ الدِّينَ شَرَائِعَهُ، وفَرَضَ فَرَائِضَهُ، وأعْلَمَ الدِّينَ عَلَامَةً يَعْلَمُهَا أَهْلُ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَحَدَّ الْحُدُودَ وَحَرَّمَ الْمَشَاعِرَ وَعَلَّمَ الْمَنَاسِكَ، وَمَضَتِ السُّنَّةُ، واسْتَتَابَ الْمُذْنِبَ، ودَعَا إِلَى الْهِجْرَةِ، وَفَتَحَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ، حُجَّةً لَهُ ونَصِيحَةً لِعِبَادِهِ، فَالْإِسْلَامُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ عَظِيمٌ شَأْنُهُ، مَعْرُوفٌ سَبِيلُهُ، لِحُقُوقِهِ مُتَفَقِّدُونَ، ولَهُ مُتَعاهِدُونَ، يَعْرِفُونَهُ ويُعْرَفُونَ بِهِ، بِالِاجْتِهَادِ بِالنِّيَّةِ، وَالِاقْتِصَادِ بِالسُّنَّةِ، لَا يَبْطُرُهُمْ عَنْهُ رَخَاءٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أصَابَهُمْ، وَلَا يُضَيِّعُونَهُ لِشِدَّةِ بَلَاءٍ نَزَلَ بِهِمْ، ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ جَاءَهُمْ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ، أَيْقَنَتْ نُفُوسُهُمْ، واطْمَأَنَّتْ بِهِ قُلُوبُهُمْ، يَسِيرُونَ مِنْهُ عَلَى أعْلَامِ نَبِيِّهِ، وَسُبِلٍ واضِحَةٍ. حُكْمٌ فَرَغَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ، لَا تَلْتَبِسُ بِهِ الْأهْوَاءُ، وَلَا تَزِيغُ بِهِ الْقُلُوبُ، عَهِدَ عَهْدَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى عِبَادِهِ، وَإِنَّمَا كَانَتْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةُ كَبَعْضِ الْأُمَمِ الَّتِي مَضَتْ قَبْلَهَا جَاءَهَا نَذِيرٌ مِنْهَا، ودَعَاها بِمَا يُحْيِيهَا، وَنَصَحَ لَهَا، وَجَهَدَ وَأَدَّى الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ، فاسْتَجَابَ لَهُ مُسْتَجِيبُونَ، وكَذَّبَ بِهِ مُكَذِّبُونَ، فَقَاتَلَ مَنْ كَذَّبَهُ بِمَنِ اسْتَجَابَ لَهُ. حَتَّى أحَلَّ حَلَالَ اللَّهِ، وَحَرَّمَ حَرَامَهُ، وَعَمِلَ بِطَاعَتِهِ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ بِهَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ مَوْعُودُ اللَّهِ، الَّذِي وَعَدَ مِنْ وُقُوعِ الْفِتْنَةِ، يُفَارِقُ رِجالٌ عَلَيْهِ رِجالًا، وَيُوالِي ⦗ص: 148⦘ رِجالٌ عَلَيْهِ رِجالًا. فَمَنْ أرَادَ أَنْ يُسَائِلَنَا عَنْ أَمْرِنَا وَرَأْيِنَا فَإِنَّا قَوْمٌ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا، وَالْإِسْلَامُ دِينُنَا، وَالْقُرْآنُ إِمَامُنَا، وَمُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّنا، إِلَيْهِ نَسْنُدُ، ونُضِيفُ أَمْرَنَا إِلَى اللَّهِ ورَسُولِهِ، ونَرْضَى مِنْ أَئِمَّتِنَا بِأَبِي بَكْرٍ وعُمَرَ، ونَرْضَى أَنْ يُطَاعَا ونَسْخَطُ أَنْ يُعْصَيَا، ونُعَادِي لَهُمَا مَنْ عادَاهُمَا، ونُرْجِي مِنْهُمْ أَهْلَ الْفُرْقَةِ الْأُوَلَ. ونُجَاهِدُ فِي أَبِي بَكْرٍ وعُمَرَ الْوِلَايَةَ، فَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وعُمَرَ لمْ تَقْتَتِلْ فيهِمَا الْأُمَّةُ، وَلَمْ تَخْتَلِفْ فيهِمَا، وَلَمْ يُشَكَّ فِي أَمْرِهِمَا، وَإِنَّمَا الْإِرْجَاءُ مِمَّنْ عَابَ الرِّجَالَ، وَلَمْ يَشْهَدْهُ، ثُمَّ عَابَ عَلَيْنَا الْإِرْجَاءَ مِنَ الْأُمَّةِ وقَالَ مَتَى كَانَ الْإِرْجَاءُ. كَانَ عَلَى عَهْدِ مُوسَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ، إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ فِرْعَونُ {مَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ الْأُولَى} طَهَ: قَالَ مُوسَى وَهُوَ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْيُ: حَتَّى قَالَ: {عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنْسَى} [طه: 52] طَهَ:. فَلَمْ يُعَنَّفْ بِمِثْلِ حُجَّةِ مُوسَى، وَمِمَّنْ نُعَادِي فِيهِمْ، شَبِيبَةٌ مُتَمَنِّيَةٌ ظَهَرُوا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وأعْلَنُوا الْفِرْيَةَ عَلَى بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ، وعَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا يُفَارِقُونَ النَّاسَ بِبَصَرٍ نَافِذٍ، وَلَا عَقْلٍ بَالِغٍ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، يَنْقُمُونَ الْمَعْصِيَةَ عَلَى مَنْ عَمِلَهَا، ويَعْمَلُونَ بِهَا. إِذَا ظَهَرُوا بِهَا يَنْصُرونَ فِتْنَتَها وَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ الْمَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا، اتَّخَذُوا أَهْلَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ إِمَامًا، وقَلَّدُوهُمْ دِينَهُمْ، يَتْلُونَ عَلَى حُبِّهِمْ ويُفَارِقُونَ عَلَى بُغْضِهِمْ، جُفَاةٌ عَلَى الْقُرْآنِ، أتْبَاعُ الْكُهَّانِ، يَرْجُونَ دَوْلَةً تَكُونُ فِي بَعْثٍ يَكُونُ قَبْلَ السَّاعَةِ، أوْ قَبْلَ قِيَامِ السَّاعَةِ، حَرَّفُوا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ، وارْتَشَوْا فِي الْحُكْمِ، وسَعَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا، وَاللَّهِ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ، وفَتَحُوا أَبْوَابًا كَانَ اللَّهُ سَدَّهَا، وسَدُّوا أَبْوابًا كَانَ اللَّهُ فَتَحَهَا، وَمِنْ خُصُومَةِ هَذِهِ الشَّبِيبَةِ الَّتِي أَدْرَكْنَا، أَنْ يَقُولُوا: هُدِينَا بِوَحْيٍ ضَلَّ عَنْهُ النَّاسُ، وَعِلْمٍ خَفِيَ، ويَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ كَتَمَ تِسْعَةَ أَعْشَارِ الْقُرْآنِ. وَلَوْ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ كاتِمًا شَيْئًا مِمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ، لَكَتَمَ شَأْنَ امْرَأَةِ زَيْدٍ {إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ} [الأحزاب: 37] الْأَحْزَابُ: وَقَوْلَهُ {لِمَ تُحَرِّمْ مَا أحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ} [التحريم: 1] التَّحْرِيمُ وَقَوْلَهُ {لَقَدْ كِدْتَ تَرْكَنَ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا} [الإسراء: 74] الْإِسْرَاءُ: فَهَذَا أَمْرُنَا ورَأْيُنَا، وَنَدْعُو إِلَى اللَّهِ مَنْ أَجَابَنَا، ونُجِيبُ إِلَيْهِ مَنْ دَعَانَا، لَا نَأْلُو فِيهِ عَنْ طَاعَةِ رَبِّنَا، وأدَاءِ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي ⦗ص: 149⦘ عَلَيْنَا، ونُذَكِّرُ بِهِ قَوْمَنَا وَمَنْ سَأَلَنَا مِنْ أَئِمَّتِنَا، فَيَسْتَحِلُّونَ بَعْدَهُ دِمَاءَنَا، أوْ يُعْرِضُوا دِمَاءَهُمْ لَنَا. فَالنَّاسُ مَجْمُوعُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ فِي مَوْطِنِ صِدْقٍ، ويَوْمَ يَكُونُ الْحَقُّ للَّهِ، ويَبْرَأُ فِيهِ الْبَائِعُ مِنَ الْمَبْيُوعِ، وَيَدْعُو الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالثُّبُورِ، فادَّخِرُوا مِنْ صَالِحِ الْحُجَجِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ لَا يَكُونُ يَظْفَرُ بِحُجَّتِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، لَمْ يَظْفَرْ بِهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ، كِتَابٌ كَتَبْتُهُ نَصِيحَةً لِمَنْ قَبْلَهُ، وَحُجَّةً عَلَى مَنْ تَرَكَهُ، وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. 'Uyayna narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Wahid b. Ayman narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyya used to command that I read this letter to the people: “To proceed: We counsel you to fear God, and urge you to His command; we are pleased for you with obedience to Him, and displeased for you with disobedience to Him. God sent down the Book with His knowledge and made it firm, and made it detailed, and made it mighty, and protected it from falsehood coming to it from before it or from behind it; He struck its parables, made clear its lessons, and made it a criterion (furqan) against evil, a light from darkness, sight from blindness, and guidance from error. Then the favor was completed, worship was perfected, the charge was preserved, the sunna ran its course and the admonition went forth, the covenant was bound, and obedience was made incumbent. So it is the firm rope of God and the most trustworthy handhold that has no breaking; by it the earlier ones advanced and by it the later ones attained: a book whose judgment He Himself took charge of, which He approved for Himself and made obligatory upon His servants. Whoever preserves it, it conveys him to what is beyond it; and whoever neglects it, nothing else will be accepted from him. To proceed: God, blessed and exalted, sent down prophethood upon Muhammad and sent him with the message, a mercy to all people, while people were then in the darkness of the Jahiliyya and its misguidance, worshipping its idols and casting lots with its divining arrows; from them they took counsel in their affairs, and by them they made lawful what they made lawful and forbade what they forbade; their religion was innovation and their call was fabrication. So God, mighty and majestic, sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth, as a mercy from Him to you and a favor He bestowed upon you; he gave you glad tidings and warned you, [reminding you of] the mention of the nations before you, and the Book recounted the story of their affair: how their messengers gave them sincere counsel, how they denied them and turned away from them, and how was God’s punishment of them. So God admonished you with the exemplary punishment of those before you and commanded you to emulate their righteous deeds. Muhammad conveyed the message, gave sincere counsel to the community, acted in obedience, and fought the enemy; God exalted His cause through him, made His light manifest through him, and perfected His word through him. He chose for him peoples who knew the right of God and acknowledged it, and who gave up their blood and wealth for Him. Among them were those who abandoned their home and kin for God, mighty and majestic, and among them were those who sheltered and aided; they consoled him with their own selves and shared with him. They did not prefer their own lives to his life. Through them God strengthened the religion, and truth crushed [p. 147] falsehood; the call of the false deities (tawaghit) was nullified, the divining arrows were broken, the worship of idols was abandoned, the caller to God was answered and the religion of God became manifest. People came to know the command of God, mighty and majestic, acknowledged God’s decree, testified to the truth, said ‘There is no god but God; Muhammad is the Messenger of God,’ and performed the obligations of God, mighty and majestic. And God gave His Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and those who responded to him, in recompense, reward, victory, promise and authority; He established for them their religion that He approved and exchanged for them, after their fear, security. Then, when God had firmly established the prohibition of disobedience to Him, the call had become pure, and Islam had been made secure for its people, He legislated the laws of the religion and decreed its obligations, set a mark of the religion that the people of Islam know, set the limits (hudud), made the sacred rites inviolable, and taught the rites of pilgrimage; the sunna passed on, He called the sinner to repent, called to emigration, and opened the door of repentance, as a proof for Himself and good counsel for His servants. Islam among its people is great in standing and its path is known; they watch over its rights and attend to it; they know it and are known by it, with striving in intention and moderation in the sunna. No ease of the world that comes upon them makes them insolent toward it, and they do not neglect it because of severe affliction that befalls them. That is because God’s command came to them; their souls became certain and their hearts were at ease with it; they proceed by it on the signposts of His Prophet and clear paths. A judgment God has finished with, by which desires are not confused and hearts do not swerve; a covenant God made with His servants. This community was only like some of the nations that passed before it: a warner came to it from among itself, and called it to what gives it life, gave it sincere counsel, strove and discharged what was upon him of the truth; some responded to him and some denied him, and he fought those who denied him with those who responded to him, until he made lawful what God made lawful, forbade what He forbade, and acted in obedience to Him. Then there came upon this community what God had promised of the occurrence of tribulation (fitna): men separate from men over it, and men [p. 148] ally with men over it. So whoever wishes to ask us about our affair and our view: we are a people whose Lord is God, whose religion is Islam, whose leader (imam) is the Qur'an, and whose Prophet is Muhammad; to him we trace back [our affair], and we refer our affair to God and His Messenger. Of our leaders we are content with Abu Bakr and 'Umar; we are pleased that they be obeyed and displeased that they be disobeyed, and we are hostile, on their behalf, to whoever is hostile to them; and we defer judgment (nurji) concerning the people of the first division. And we strive for the allegiance (wilaya) of Abu Bakr and 'Umar, for the community did not fight over Abu Bakr and 'Umar, nor differ about them, nor was there doubt about their affair. Deferral (irja') is only [for the case of] those who found fault with the men without having witnessed it, and then found fault with us for deferral from the community and said: When was there deferral? It was in the time of Moses, the prophet of God, when Pharaoh said to him “What of the former generations?” [Q. 20:51]; Moses said, while revelation was coming down upon him, until He said: “Their knowledge is with my Lord in a record; my Lord neither errs nor forgets” [Q. 20:52]. So he was not reproached with the like of Moses’ proof. And among those we are hostile to are a wishful youth (shabiba mutamanniya) who have appeared with the Book of God, and have publicly spread slander against the Banu Umayya and against God; they do not part from the people with penetrating insight or mature reason in Islam. They resent disobedience in those who commit it, and they commit it themselves. When they gain the upper hand through it, they support its tribulation and do not know the way out of it. They have taken a household (ahl bayt) of the Arabs as imam and followed them blindly in their religion; they follow in love of them and part ways in hatred of them; coarse toward the Qur'an, followers of soothsayers; they hope for a dominion to come with a resurrection (ba'th) that will occur before the Hour, or before the rising of the Hour. They distorted the Book of God, took bribes in judgment, and strove in the land to spread corruption—and God does not love the corrupters; they opened doors that God had closed, and closed doors that God had opened. And part of the disputation of this youth whom we have met is that they say: We have been guided by a revelation from which the people have gone astray, and by knowledge that was hidden; and they claim that the Prophet of God concealed nine-tenths of the Qur'an. Yet if the Prophet of God had been concealing anything of what God sent down, he would have concealed the matter of Zayd’s wife, “when you said to him on whom God had bestowed favor” [Q. 33:37] (al-Ahzab), and His saying “Why do you forbid what God has made lawful for you?” [Q. 66:1] (al-Tahrim), and His saying “You were about to incline to them a little” [Q. 17:74] (al-Isra'). This, then, is our affair and our view. We call to God whoever responds to us, and respond to Him whoever calls us, not falling short in it of obedience to our Lord and of discharging the right [p. 149] that is upon us; and we remind our people of it, and whoever asks us among our leaders, [but] after it they deem our blood lawful—or expose their own blood to us. People will be gathered before their Lord in a station of truth, on a day when the truth belongs to God, when the seller disowns what is sold, and when man calls upon himself for destruction. So store up righteous proofs with God, for whoever does not succeed with his proof in this world will not succeed with it in the Hereafter. [This is] a letter I have written as sincere counsel for whoever receives it and a proof against whoever abandons it. Peace be upon the messengers, and praise be to God, Lord of the worlds.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: A believer does not commit treacherous assassination (fatk)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِلزُّبَيْرِ أَلَا أَقْتُلُ لَكَ عَلِيًّا قَالَ: كَيْفَ تَقْتُلُهُ؟ قَالَ: أَغْتَالُهُ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «الْإِيمَانُ قَيَّدَ الْفَتْكَ لَا يَفْتِكُ مُؤْمِنٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, from Ayyub, from al-Hasan, that a man said to al-Zubayr:
entries.matn_en: Shall I kill 'Ali for you? He said: How would you kill him? He said: I would assassinate him. He said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Faith has shackled treachery (fatk); a believer does not commit treacherous assassination.”
